# Tague Lumber

> Professional building materials supplier and design showroom serving contractors, builders, and homeowners across the Greater Philadelphia Area including Bucks County, Montgomery County, Kennett Square, and Doylestown.

Tague Lumber provides comprehensive builder services including material takeoffs, construction consulting, and value engineering, alongside custom millwork fabrication and full-service kitchen & bath design showrooms. The company serves professional contractors and residential customers throughout southeastern Pennsylvania.

## Key Topics

- Building Materials
- Custom Millwork
- Kitchen & Bath Design
- Builder Services
- Material Takeoffs
- Construction Consulting
- Design Showrooms
- Fireplace Mantels
- Exterior Siding

- Tool Demonstrations

## Core Services

- [Tague Design Showroom | Kitchen & Bath Showrooms in PA](https://www.taguelumber.com/design-showroom): Kitchen & bath showrooms in Malvern and Doylestown, PA locations
- [Builder Services - Tague Lumber](https://www.taguelumber.com/services/builder-services): Professional builder services including material takeoffs & consulting
- [Custom Millwork Division | Tague Lumber](https://www.taguelumber.com/custom-millwork-division): Custom millwork fabrication for architectural elements & restoration

## Product Categories

- [Siding | Exterior Siding Materials & Displays | Tague Lumber](https://www.taguelumber.com/design-showroom/siding): Exterior siding displays featuring fiber cement, wood & composite options
- [Fireplace Mantels & Surrounds | Custom Mantels | Tague Lumber](https://www.taguelumber.com/custom-millwork-division/fireplace-mantels-surrounds): Custom fireplace mantels and historic reproduction surrounds
- [Moulding Combination Profiles - Tague Lumber](https://www.taguelumber.com/lumber-building-products/moulding-and-millwork/moulding/moulding-combination-profiles): Moulding combination profiles catalog for trim and millwork products
